numerical_recomputation.notes: The deterministic graph algorithm demonstrates only cycle detection over a declared edge set; it runs no threads, locks, interrupts, weak-memory execution or kernel code and cannot prove edge completeness.

evidence: Re-derived conflict as one operation's write set intersecting the other's read-or-write set and checked that conflicts require ordering or a formally defined atomic or lockless rule.
